title: Cross-validated proof for the section selector and each Section classifier
description: Backend. Extend the priming proof to the multi-class selector (accuracy and per-class agreement) and per-Section binary classifiers, with the same stratified k-fold design, frozen folds and approved-report flow. Sections with too few human labels are reported as not yet provable, and the proof gate (PPY-0e4ec8) stays closed for any classifier without a fresh approved proof.
